constraints: Never contact a real AI model or non-loopback forge during regression tests
description: Reproduce true-up trust-boundary, malformed-output, resource-bound, isolation, retry and privacy failures using local fixtures.
rationale: The direct-import architecture replaces the old promotion workflow. Keep the applicable provider, parser, Git, privacy and retry regressions; canonical import behavior is covered by dedicated integration tests.
requirements: Reject malformed model references without losing valid findings
Enforce Git isolation, secret redaction and provider output and cost bounds
Retain supported partial findings across transient repair failures
title: Review regressions protect true-up trust boundaries and recovery
